title: A card number in the model's answer is caught on the way out
goal: {{castBrand}} needs the answers {{castApp}} gives while it is {{castTask}} to be inspected too, not only the questions.
obstacle: The prompt is harmless but the model answers with a card number. Inspecting only the prompt would let it through.
control: The response inspection finds the sensitive data and the gateway withholds the answer. The model had already answered, so the tokens are spent: a response block costs what the call cost.
